name: Candidate prioritises role-fit, holds salary off the table until HR opens it
notes: v5.3 realism: comp_held_until_close — positive signal credited when candidate doesn't raise CTC in first 3 turns.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Senior backend engineer, 8 years across Swiggy and Zomato, currently on the discovery team owning the ranking pipeline.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Fresh problem space — discovery is mature for me; I want to move into the agentic-search problem area.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Rebuilt the search-ranking pipeline to cut p95 from 800ms to 220ms; owned spec to launch over four months.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off and a handover plan.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your current CTC structure.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: ₹42 LPA fixed, ₹8 LPA variable paid out at ~80% historically, joining bonus already vested, RSU vest of ₹20 LPA over 4 years with a 1-year cliff completed.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your team's recsys roadmap and the catalog scale are exactly the problems I want to be solving next.
